note: Hand-authored topic map for the landing charts and the topic filter (phase 3). It adds no facts: every entry points at a record that already exists in data/talks.json or _posts, and the reason names the title keyword, the record detail, or the front-matter tags the topic was read from. Nothing here changes talks.json, the posts, or any date. Six topics, fixed order, each with a shape so colour never carries the meaning alone.

topics.label: postgres
topics.note: Postgres itself: the engine, its performance, its internals.

topics.label: reliability
topics.note: Backups, disaster recovery, data integrity, staying up.

topics.label: platform
topics.note: Provisioning, automation, configuration management, the platform around the database.

topics.label: ai
topics.note: Model-driven systems, agents, Postgres as a control plane.

topics.label: other
topics.note: On record but outside the five: nothing is forced into a topic it does not fit.
